```yaml
name: Update compat-table dependency

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Every Monday 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-compat-table:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          all_but_latest: true
          ignore_sha: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js and pnpm
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm
          pnpm-version: 8

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Get latest compat-table SHA
        id: latest_sha
        run: |
          LATEST_SHA=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/compat-table/compat-table/commits/main | jq -r .sha)
          echo "sha=$LATEST_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Read current compat-table SHA
        id: current_sha
        run: |
          CURRENT_SHA=$(jq -r '.dependencies["compat-table"]' tasks/compat_data/package.json | tr -d '"')
          echo "sha=$CURRENT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Compare SHAs
        id: compare
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.latest_sha.outputs.sha }}" != "${{ steps.current_sha.outputs.sha }}" ]; then
            echo "needs_update=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "needs_update=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update package.json, rebuild, and push changes
        if: steps.compare.outputs.needs_update == 'true'
        run: |
          NEW_SHA=${{ steps.latest_sha.outputs.sha }}
          BRANCH="update-compat-table-${NEW_SHA}"

          # Create a new branch
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH"

          # Update the dependency SHA
          jq --arg sha "$NEW_SHA" '.dependencies["compat-table"] = $sha' tasks/compat_data/package.json > tmp && mv tmp tasks/compat_data/package.json

          # Rebuild compatibility data
          pnpm run init
          pnpm run build

          # Commit all changes
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add tasks/compat_data/package.json
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: update compat-table to $NEW_SHA"

          # Push the branch
          git push --set-upstream origin "$BRANCH"

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.compare.outputs.needs_update == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const branch = 'update-compat-table-${{ steps.latest_sha.outputs.sha }}';
            const pr = await github.rest.pulls.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: 'chore: update compat-table to latest commit',
              head: branch,
              base: 'main',
              body: `Updated compat-table from ${{ steps.current_sha.outputs.sha }} to ${{ steps.latest_sha.outputs.sha }}.\n\nThis updates the compatibility data to the latest commit.`,
              assignees: ['Boshen']
            });
            console.log(`Created PR #${pr.data.number}`);
```
